title: AvionTEq adds CTRL Systems ultrasound equipment to aviation maintenance portfolio
summary: This will empower aircraft maintenance organizations with new and innovative solutions to assist with locating leaks and diagnosing issues with aircraft systems.
body_markdown:
AvionTEq is now complemented with an additional strategic relationship with CTRL Systems and this is where new equipment can now be offered.


This will empower aircraft maintenance organizations with new and innovative solutions to assist with locating leaks and diagnosing issues with aircraft systems.


One of the most notable pieces of equipment is the UL101 Aviation Troubleshooter (P/N B00033) by CTRL Systems. When a leak occurs on a pressurized system like a pitot-static system, cabin pressure or even the hydraulic system, then the UL101 has the technology to accurately detect this.


Employ ultrasonic troubleshooting techniques on this equipment and troubleshoot what you suspect to be a source of a leak. Also, technicians can seamlessly integrate it into the traditional aircraft maintenance practices.


This equipment is compatible with existing scope of aviation test equipment, as well as air data test sets and avionic testers. AvionTEq provides many other essential items of equipment making them a one stop shop.


For more information about the[CTRL Systems UL101 Aviation Troubleshooter](https://www.avionteq.com/CTRL-Systems-B00033-UL101-Aviation-Troubleshooter) , visit them online.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by AvionTEq.*
